{{Quote|Jilam Kester is confirmed as being on Celen. This contains your charts, building plans, and informant contact details. Bring him back alive.|[[Sa Cuis]] to [[Squad 40]]|<ref name="IC:501st" />}}
The '''Mission to Celen''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] operation during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] to capture the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] [[Jilam Kester]], who was charged with aiding refugee [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escape capture by the Empire, three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the formation of the Galactic Empire. The mission was assigned to [[Squad 40]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], which was made up of [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army's]] [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] that had survived the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="IC:501st" />

After being briefed by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Sa Cuis]], Squad 40 was deployed to [[Chelpori]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celen]], where Kester was spotted by the local security forces. Kester's [[Jilam Kester's base|hideout]] was monitored extensively by the local forces up until Squad 40 arrived. The squad was composed of [[Niner Skirata|RC-1309]], nicknamed "Niner," and [[Darman Skirata]], who were formerly from [[Omega Squad]], as well as [[Ennen|IC-4447]], nicknamed "Ennen," and [[Bry (clone trooper)|Bry]], who were formerly of [[Galaar Squad]]. They stormed Jilam's hideout, where they expected to encounter minimal resistance. They were surprised when they came face to face with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Iri Camas]], the former [[Director of Special Forces]] and ultimately the commandos' old superior. Camas distracted the commandos, allowing Kester to escape, and ended his own life by igniting a gas line and causing the building to explode. Bry was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the explosion while the rest of the squad managed to escape.<ref name="IC:501st" />
